First, we move all the terms to the left side of the inequality and factor:

$$
\begin{aligned}-10\cdot {5}^{2-7x}+3x\cdot {5}^{2-7x} & >-{5}^{2-7x}{x}^{2} \\ {5}^{2-7x}{x}^{2}-10\cdot {5}^{2-7x}+3x\cdot {5}^{2-7x} & >0 \\ ({x}^{2}+3x-10){5}^{2-7x} & >0 \\ (x+5)(x-2){5}^{2-7x} & >0\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we divide both sides by ${5}^{2-7x}$ and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{(x+5)(x-2){5}^{2-7x}}{{5}^{2-7x}} & >\frac{0}{{5}^{2-7x}} \\ (x+5)(x-2) & >0.\end{aligned}
$$

This represents an upwards parabola whose roots are at $x=-5$ and $x=2.$ The parabola is above the $x$-axis when $x<-5$ or $x>2.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14013930/assets/6b72efca34700ab06986460d4d190e0e83a4f0068c9effe20af622082a92b9a9.png)

Therefore, the solution to the inequality is $x<-5$ or $x>2.$
